reasoning_content:
ddev started successfully. Now run composer install. Let's use ddev composer install. This may take a while. Run in background with logging.

Note the guide says `ddev composer install`. Let's do it as ddevuser.

action.command: su ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/bin && nohup ddev composer install > /tmp/composer_install.log 2>&1 & echo "PID $!"'; sleep 30; tail -20 /tmp/composer_install.log

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "su ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/bin && nohup ddev composer install > /tmp/composer_install.log 2>&1 & echo \"PID $!\"'; sleep 30; tail -20 /tmp/composer_install.log", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Run composer install in background"}
